source: New executed AWS Bank of Anthos workload after localization revision freeze

protocol.source: Prospective new AWS execution; same demo application and host class. Not cross-application generalization.
protocol.labels_policy: Intervention log separate. All window predictions are written before evaluation-only labels are read.
protocol.measurement_policy: Cgroup and PostgreSQL snapshots every 2 seconds; expensive serial Java probes omitted. Missing queue and backend spans remain missing.

protocol.threshold: Maximum validation-window next-step error, frozen before evaluation
protocol.graph: Only completed frontend CLIENT spans observed by training cutoff; peer addresses establish client-observed edges, not backend server spans
protocol.development_status: Retrospective within-recording study after exploratory inspection; not independent banking generalization

limitations: One new executed workload after the investigator rules were frozen. Models use its normal prefix, with a 72-second normal holdout; this is not cross-recording model transfer.
Graph has only measured frontend client-observed edges; database dependency edges were not instrumented.
Missing values are masked; no interpolation or copied future observations. Client timings are not backend server timings.
Ranking errors and anomaly thresholds are not causal confidence or a validated banking production detector.

Six controlled CPU/database repetitions in one new workload on one AWS host; not six independent applications or infrastructures.
The revision was frozen before this workload. GNNs are still trained independently on its normal prefix; cross-recording transfer is not claimed.
Graph and identity variants share the same direct-evidence rules; any improvement from those rules does not establish graph superiority.
Higher traffic is a load condition, not automatically a fault. Its two repetitions are retained but excluded from injected root-service accuracy.
The corrective code uses authoritative reads and may increase database work. Demonstrated correctness under these tests is not universal production certification.
